claim: Derive a routine's original time by running the routine itself on the snapshot's memory at build time, or fit it to the drawing routines' time, rather than guessing a constant.

evidence.text: Time by size and shift comes from running the routine at build time: hooks within 0.01% at the first try, no fitting from recordings.
Fitting the original's update against the drawing routines' time left a residual of 0.4 ms of 70.
Copy target fitted as 21 T per row and column plus 140 T per row; fits by seed ran 19.9 to 23.0 T, attributed to screen contention.
